_doc: Armour, shield, ring and amulet rules (bug bash 3.3.2; docs/design/ARMOR_REDESIGN_PLAN.md, revision 3; numbers from tools/balance/armor_model.py). The floor only decides which level is likely to be found; every magnitude is fixed per level (LORE NOT FLOOR).

levels._doc: Enchantment level 1-10 (0 = plain). Tier = ceil(level / 2): the quiz tier and the plus on body armour and shields. Each level is drawn by a bell by floor; a level cannot appear before its first floor.

loot_split._doc: What a find of common gear is (Brandon's ruling, revision 2: armour has seven more slots than a weapon, so as many armour pieces as weapons): weapon / armour / shield. An armour find is any of the eight slots, evenly (pick_random_armor_for_floor). Floor rooms, monster drops and chests' gear all roll it (gear.pick_gear_class).

weight_class_bells._doc: Which weight class of template a find is, by floor: [peak, spread, first floor]. Plate on floor 3 was the early-AC spike of the first model pass. Body armour and shields carry a bell of their own instead (`spawn_bell` in the template, gear.template_weight, 2026-11-12), so each arrives in its turn: by weight class alone full plate could be found from floor 12 and was worn by floor 30.

threshold._doc: Complexity and benefit set the threshold (Brandon's ruling): complexity is the weight class, benefit the tier; a named unique asks two more; at most max. Each KIND is asked only once a run (Known by Hand, src/known_by_hand.py, winning-build plan 3.4, 2026-11-13), so the numbers rose by one (light / medium / heavy were 1 / 2 / 3, unique +1, cap 5): geography is untimed and every topic has a teaching card, and at 97% a threshold of 6 still passes 83% of the time.

accessory_threshold._doc: Rings, amulets and belts (history): complexity by slot, benefit by tier, same cap. Asked once a kind, like armour (were ring 1, amulet 2, belt 2, unique +1, cap 5).

donning._doc: Turns to put a piece on (winning-build plan 3.4): body armour by its weight class, the full plate template its own, shields, minor armour pieces, rings, amulets and belts one. Taking a piece off takes doff_share of that, rounded up. Until a piece is fully on its slot counts as empty (src/game_dressing.py). The Hephaestus quirk halves both, rounded up (fast_share).

enchant_cap._doc: The most plus an Enchant Armour scroll can raise a core piece to; a minor piece's scroll raises its enchantment one level instead.

named_ac._doc: The least AC (base + plus) a named body armour or shield found by depth gives: the common par of its peak floor (the mean a hero wears there, from nothing worn, by the game's own spawns) plus the margin. Written by tools/balance/rebase_unique_armour.py; read by gear.named_ac_floor and the named-armour ladder pass. Starting and quest pieces keep their own.

armour_weight._doc: What the BODY armour's weight class lets through (winning-build plan 3.3, slice 4; Brandon 2026-11-13: 'BALANCE armor and Dex (light vs heavy)... so that there are many ways to play'). No body armour counts as light. dex_ac_cap: the most AC Dexterity gives ((DEX - 10) // 2; a clumsy hero's minus always counts). dodge_share: the share of the dodge (Dexterity's and worn gear's) still there. footsteps: tiles further the hero's steps carry (senses.step_radius), and metal_footsteps more in metal unless the material is quiet (mithril, godweave); each such tile makes a deep sleeper sleeper_share_per_tile readier to stir (sleepers.factor). casting_mult: what a spell's mana costs in METAL body armour, unless the material casts freely (mithril, orichalcum, godweave). The template's forms and the material's elements are in the template and material files (gear.py, What armour does beyond AC).

load._doc: Weight that bites (plan 3.3): over burdened.share of the carry limit the hero is Burdened, over stressed.share Stressed (over the limit itself he is still Stressed, and nothing more can be picked up). dodge: the share of the dodge left. step_every: every Nth step a Stressed hero takes costs the dungeon one more turn. How much further the steps carry is in data/senses.json noise (burdened, stressed). Before 2026-11-13 there was one line, at 75%, and it cost one extra turn every fourth step.

wards._doc: What a body armour's material stops outright (its `wards`, gear.ward_against): an attack's rider of one of these effects, from an attacker of one of these families or tags (none listed: from anything). card: the words on the item card; line: what the log says when it fires ({piece} is the piece as the hero knows it).

fey_glamour.card: cold iron: fey glamour slides off
fey_glamour.line: Your {piece} is cold iron, and the glamour slides off it.

flame.line: Your {piece} will not catch, and the flames die on it.
